transcript: Good morning, what should I call you? I am Aarumethha. What brings you in today, Aarum? I have had fever and body pain since yesterday. Alright, take Paracetamol 500mg, 1 tablet twice daily, after food for 3 days. Drink plenty of water. Ok, doctor.

prescription.notes: Patient Aarumethha presents with fever and body pain since yesterday. Doctor recommends Paracetamol 500mg twice daily after food for 3 days and advises drinking plenty of water.
